solution_summary: Thread AI partners with Google Cloud to help organizations deploy reliable, governed AI workflows in business-critical processes. Organizations across industries have embraced AI technologies to work faster and do more. But the dream of end-to-end automated business processes remains out of reach for many. Companies often can’t afford the time and resources needed to create and maintain custom integrations for dozens of tools. The flagship product, Lemma, is a composable AI infrastructure and workflow orchestration platform that makes developing agentic workflows with enterprise security and compliance guardrails as easy as drag-and-drop. It’s flexible and can work with any AI or system, allowing customers to design custom orchestrations even as models evolve and grow, reusing proprietary components to compound value and speed time to value across the organization.
